analysis: {'Project A': {'Pros': ['• Clearer value proposition: The concept of a social travel app addressing a specific pain point (fragmented trip planning) is relatively understandable.', '• approach (initial focus, user interviews, A/B testing) demonstrates a degree of planning and validation.', '• Revenue model considered: Exploring freemium and commission-based models shows awareness
